whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Soda Fountain & Milk Bar,

I noticed your iconic milk bar has strong 3.6★ reviews with over 1,600+ patrons near Mona Cinema in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for quick menu browsing and home delivery inquiries.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp order/table booking, classic menu showcase, aur Google Maps location integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/sodafountain

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine The Soda Fountain & Milk Bar ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with your classic menu showcase, direct WhatsApp ordering, and location details right by Mona Cinema in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
